feedback: Pre-race review of the iteration 9 candidate. It keeps the iteration 8 controller (base_speed 1.1, kp 1.8, kd 0.3, ki 0, last_direction, sensor_weights [2,1,0,-1,-2]) and the narrow five-sensor layout (x = 0.03, 0.015, 0, -0.015, -0.03; y = 0.05), and changes one variable: sensor_size from 0.012 to 0.016. The best raced design is iteration 8 at 366.7. Its oval line loss (0.30) and max_error (0.044) are the strongest raced values, and the s-bend (1.0 line loss, 0 of 20 finishes) and slalom (1.0 line loss, progress 0.17) are still the gap. The footprint is the one geometry variable not yet tested alone. Iteration 2 showed that widening the spacing hurt (score 81.1), and this candidate keeps the 15 mm spacing, so that result does not apply directly. The candidate is valid, within contract limits, and not obviously broken. Its controller values match the best raced design, so the race isolates the footprint effect. Risk to watch: at 16 mm the neighbouring footprints overlap more, so readings may saturate and lose fine offset resolution on the oval. Read the result against the iteration 8 baseline on each track: completion, progress, completion_time, line_loss_events, max_error and steering_oscillation, plus noise_robustness. Next step depends on the race. If oval line_loss_events or max_error rise above iteration 8 levels (0.30 and 0.044), or oval completion falls, revert sensor_size to 0.012 and keep kp 1.8. If line loss falls on the s-bend or slalom while oval holds, keep sensor_size 0.016 and test one further single change, such as a small kp step, rather than stacking changes. Do not change the spacing: the wide array in iteration 2 did not help line retention.
requested_changes: If oval line_loss_events (above 0.30) or max_error (above 0.044) rise against iteration 8, or oval completion drops below the iteration 8 rate of 18 of 20, revert sensor_size to 0.012 and keep kp 1.8, base_speed 1.1 and kd 0.3, since iteration 8 is the best raced baseline at 366.7.

If the s-bend or slalom line_loss_events fall below 1.0 with the oval held, keep sensor_size 0.016 and make one further single change, a small kp step to about 1.6, since the kp trend from 2.5 to 2.0 to 1.8 cut line loss on every track.

Keep the five-sensor spacing at x = 0.03, 0.015, 0, -0.015, -0.03 and sensor_weights [2,1,0,-1,-2] unchanged, since iteration 2 (22.5 mm spacing) dropped the score to 81.1 without improving line loss, and iteration 7 (kd 0.25) dropped it to 163.3.
